title: Regional Benches Establishment
description: Exception to the ordinary functioning place of the National Commission

content.general_rule: The National Commission shall ordinarily function at the National Capital Region
content.exception: The Central Government may establish regional Benches of the National Commission at other places
conditions: in consultation with the National Commission
